name: Ginza Canon Gallery
about_text: Canon Gallery Ginza is one of three Canon-run photography galleries in Japan, alongside spaces in Shinagawa and Osaka. It began in 1973 as the Canon Salon on Ginza 5-chome, offering a venue and support desk for professional photographers, and was renamed Canon Gallery Ginza in 2005 when it moved to its current Ginza 3-chome location. The space runs juried, open-submission exhibitions—open to professionals and amateurs alike—on roughly two-week rotations, with many shows later touring to Canon Gallery Osaka. It also hosts several company-curated exhibitions each year and sits adjacent to the Canon Photo House Ginza.

notes: Site describes Canon Gallery as a corporate exhibition space run by Canon Marketing Japan for open-submission and curated photography exhibitions; it does not represent artists in a gallery-roster sense, so no roster entries apply. The 'about' page lists photographers whose works are held in the Canon Photo Collection (a corporate collection), not a represented-artist roster.

triage.site_notes: This is Canon's huge consumer product site (personal.canon.jp); the Ginza Canon Gallery is only a small subsection under /showroom/gallery, with an overview/about page and per-location pages (Ginza, Osaka, Shinagawa) but no dedicated current/archive exhibition listing or artist roster was found in the crawl.
